title: Format todos as a Markdown checklist
source: Recurring Reminders/notes -> Markdown-checklist ('- [ ]'/'- [x]') demand — Apple Shortcut pulling Reminders into an Obsidian markdown note; ReminderSync App Store app uses the same format. https://fulcra.design/Posts/Automatically-download-Reminders-into-your-Obsidian-notes-with-Shortcuts/
signature: function formatTodos(items)  // items: {title:string, done:boolean}[] -> string (Markdown checklist)
prompt: Write a JavaScript function `formatTodos(items)` that takes an array of objects like { title: string, done: boolean } and returns a Markdown checklist string: one line per item, '- [x] ' + title if done is true, otherwise '- [ ] ' + title. Join the lines with a single newline and add no trailing newline. Return an empty string for an empty array.
